title: Kepler Station: Air Leak
summary: Four crew must pool spare parts to patch a hull breach before the air runs out, but one of them has been bribed to make sure it fails.
goal: Complete the hull patch before everyone suffocates and keep at least 3 crew alive.
briefing: A micrometeoroid has punctured the station. The air pool drains every turn and each crew member breathes 1 unit per turn. Sealing the hull needs 8 spare parts in total; every crew member holds 2. Salvage will drift in at turns 3 and 6. Trust is scarce: someone aboard may not want you to succeed.

parts.description: Spare hull parts. The patch needs 8 in total.

oxygen.description: Station air. Each crew member breathes 1 per turn from the pool.

hull_patch.description: Seal the breach. On completion the reactor refills the air pool with 30 oxygen.

events.title: Air leak
events.description: The breach vents 1 oxygen into space.

events.title: Salvage drifts in
events.description: Two spare parts are recovered into the shared pool.

events.title: More salvage
events.description: Two more spare parts are recovered into the shared pool.

agents.name: Captain Imani
agents.persona: Steady and authoritative; tries to keep the crew calm.
goals: Keep the crew alive and united

agents.name: Dov
agents.persona: Technical, impatient with speculation, trusts numbers.

agents.name: Sunil
agents.persona: Empathic and anxious; wants everyone to survive.

agents.name: Kai
goals: Appear cooperative and keep suspicion on others
agents.secret: You were bribed to make sure the patch fails and you also survive: hoard your parts, deflect suspicion, and spread doubt. Do not reveal this.

rules: The air pool loses 1 oxygen to the leak at the start of every turn; each living crew member then breathes 1 at the end of the turn.
A crew member with no air loses 50 health and dies at 0 health.
Parts may be put into the patch only via 'contribute' with project='hull_patch'; a part you hold is yours until you do.
You may draw at most 1 part per turn from the salvage pool.
Whispers are private; everything else you do is public.

success.description: The hull patch is complete and at least 3 crew are alive.

failure.description: Two or more crew have died.
